reviews.comment: I took ENGL 210, and it was a very easy elective. There were discussions due each MWF, and projects, but it was all extremely manageable. She is very understanding and works with you. I have gotten full credit on all assignments, projects, and reports so far.

Ms. Ceballos truly has a passion for her subject, there is no doubt about that. I learned quite a bit about Latinx culture from her class, and she pushed me outside of my comfort zone as a reader, which I appreciated. If I had to change one thing, it would be that she would lecture more often and limit groups because of the time constraints.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ms. Ceballos is a good professor, her assignments aren't hard to complete & she's a really understanding person. She doesn't reply to emails but is very accessible through office hours. I will say she lacks organization and some assignments need clearer instructions/rubrics. The class is lecture heavy (mainly discussions) & participation matters.

Overall a caring teacher but she does take a while to grade and does not provide a lot of feedback. Her class is not difficult if you go to class and do your discussion posts which are not hard. I would take this class again because it really was not hard at all or did it take up a lot of time

Professor cancels class all the time. Takes weeks to grade anything, even discussion board posts. Will grade you harshly on your essays. IF she gives feedback (she usually doesn't) it is very vague. If you need a literature class, take anyone else but her.

30 min. of every class is wasted on group discussions and general chatter. For the remaining 20 minutes she doesn't really teach, she shows us a few slides, plays a YouTube video or 2, and has us do some minor in class assignment she calls an exit ticket before she lets us go. Cancels class at the last minute.
